features.quote: Upper bound: 50 turns, if you want late-stage degradation
minimization of unnecessary prolonged adversarial loops, keeping tasks bounded, logging only what you need, avoiding open-ended escalation beyond the research question.
features.justification_quote: If you think models might have morally relevant states, then repeated exposure to adversarial failure loops may itself deserve scrutiny as a potential harm analogue.
